# brainmapper


## Combining registration and cell detection

Often we want to combine atlas registration and cell detection, to answer questions like: how many cells are in each brain region? Anatomical context

## Pulling things together: `brainmapper` CLI

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column}
* `brainmapper` is the name of [our command line tool](https://brainglobe.info/tutorials/brainmapper/index.html) to combine cell detection and atlas registration.

::::

## `brainmapper` CLI

* Required arguments
  * `-s` The primary signal channel
  * `-b` The secondary autofluorescence channel
  * `-o` The output directory 
  * `--orientation` e.g. `psl`
  * `-v` The voxel spacing (microns) in the same order as the data orientation (`psl`): 5 2 2.
  * `--atlas`

## `brainmapper` CLI

* allows batching on HPC
* flexible: can switch each of registration, detection, classification on and off independently

## Slurm tricks

* move data close to compute
